result:
The decisive mistake was at step 5. The Orchestrator accepted the Bing results without checking proximity. Several of those gyms are clearly not within 200 m of Tompkins Square Park, for example Equinox Flatiron at 897 Broadway, which the later screenshot shows at 1.8 km. It then told WebSurfer to check class schedules for all five gyms. That sent the work down the wrong path, and the final answer included gyms outside the radius. It also never turned up Avea Pilates, one of the two correct answers.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 5
